verdict.rationale: cubic's core function is AI-generated insight and suggestions from the user's code data inside the product. Documented features include AI review comments on bugs and improvements, a context-aware chat sidebar with 'tour this PR' and 'Add to AI chat', one-click 'Fix with cubic', codebase scans, an AI wiki with architecture diagrams, and requirement analysis against linked Linear/Jira issues. Some community users report useful, contextual comments. Missing for 10: the analytics dashboard is not described as producing AI-generated insights over team/delivery data, and independent hands-on corroboration of suggestion quality is limited and mixed.
